# Savewave

> Savewave is a privacy-first, local-media downloader for Windows and Android with a static GitHub Pages landing website.

## Overview

- **Workflow**: Paste → Resolve → Preview → Save.
- **Website**: GitHub Pages landing site (https://savewave.kuberbassi.com/) for app setup and APK downloads. No web extraction.
- **Local Extraction**: Runs on-device via bundled `yt-dlp` and `FFmpeg` (Tauri desktop & native Android engine).
- **Supported Sources**: Public YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), SoundCloud, Direct Media, and Spotify Smart Match.
- **Privacy**: Zero accounts, zero remote database, zero cloud media storage, and bounded local history.
- **Unsupported**: Private, login-gated, cookie-only, paid, and DRM-protected media.
